text: かまれたとき　あたまに　しみこんだ　どくそに　よって　ただならない　のうりょくに　めざめた　ヤドン。

structure.jp: あたまに　しみこんだ　どくそに　よって
structure.en: because of the toxins that seeped into its head

structure.jp: ただならない　のうりょくに　めざめた　ヤドン。
structure.en: a Slowpoke that awakened to extraordinary abilities

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あたまに　しみこんだ　どくそ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing, like English 'that...'. あたまに　しみこんだ　どくそ = 'the toxins that seeped into its head'.

patterns.name: 〜によって
patterns.explanation: によって after a thing says that thing is the cause of what follows. どくそに　よって = 'because of the toxins'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending says the action was done to it, not by it. かまれた = 'was bitten'.
